[[Charity Watch]][10] [[Charity Navigator]][11]


#### NRDC is a top-rated charity

Donations will be used to fight climate change, defend wildlife and public lands, and for other
campaigns that allow NRDC to protect the environment in the most effective way possible. Your
tax-deductible donation will automatically be applied towards your NRDC membership.

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) combines the power of more than 3 million members and
supporters with the expertise of some 700 scientists, lawyers, and other staff to confront the
climate crisis, protect wildlife and wild places, and ensure clean air, clean water, and healthy
communities.

#### Prefer to donate by mail?

Please use our [printable donation form][12]. To donate by phone, call 212-727-2700.

Contact us at [membership@nrdc.org][13] or 212-727-2700.

The Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC) is a tax-exempt 501(c)3 organization. Contributions to
NRDC are tax-deductible to the fullest extent of the law. NRDC's tax ID is 13-2654926.

View [NRDC's financial statement online][14] or write to the Office of Charities Registration, 162
Washington Avenue, Albany, NY 12231. View [NRDC's latest IRS 990 form][15]. View [NRDC's State
Disclosure information][16].

## BIOMED - the perfect blend of **science** & nature

Our mineral-plant complex based on arginine and natural extract with Calcium Hydroxyapatite combines
the natural science of plants with innovations to strengthen tooth enamel and reduce sensitivity.

In vitro studies in Switzerland have also proved our products have a soothing effect on gums.

At Charleston Center for Cosmetic and Restorative Dentistry, Dr. John Rink blends artistry,
innovation, and integrity to deliver handcrafted, life-changing smile transformations. With decades
of experience and a refined aesthetic eye, [Dr. Rink][156] is trusted by patients seeking the
highest level of cosmetic excellence.

## Your Charleston Home for Cosmetic Dentistry

You don’t have to live with concerns about your teeth or the feeling that you have to hide your
smile anymore. At the Charleston Center for Cosmetic and Restorative Dentistry, we provide

## Dr. John F. Rink The Cosmetic Expert

Dr. Rink has been delivering outstanding aesthetic results for 40 years, establishing his reputation
as one of the most reliable, friendly, and skilled dental practitioners in his field. Dr. Rink
obtained his undergraduate and dental degrees from the University of North Carolina School of
Dentistry at Chapel Hill, and completed a demanding fellowship in implant dentistry at the
Bowman-Gray School of Medicine. Additionally, he is a graduate of the L.D. Pankey Institute for
Advanced Dental Education. Dr. Rink is Charleston’s first accredited dentist in the [American
Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry][167], the world’s leading organization in aesthetic dentistry.
Dentists that have achieved this accreditation status have demonstrated the highest level of skill
and expertise and are committed to excellence in responsible aesthetics. Dr Rink is one of fewer
than 450 dentists in the world that have achieved AACD accreditation status.

[ Read Bio ][168]

## Full Mouth Restoration

When all the teeth in the patient’s mouth are in need of replacement, full mouth restoration is
performed to reestablish a healthy smile. Those who have suffered injury or accidents, were born
with congenital conditions, or who have a history of decaying, cracked, or otherwise damaged teeth
may be the best candidates. Treatments may include crowns, [bridges][169], veneers, implants, or
dentures, with every procedure tailored to your unique needs and wishes.

[Learn More About Full Mouth Restoration][170]

## Smile Makeover

One of the specialty services at our South Carolina practice is a smile makeover — a combination of
restorative dentistry procedures that can dramatically improve your smile and has the ability to
change your life. Dr. John Rink will craft a custom set of dental services that work together to
achieve your goal of having a smile that complements all your best features.

[Learn More About Smile Makeover][171]

## Prepless Porcelain Veneers

Prepless veneers are an excellent option for those who want to improve the aesthetics of their
teeth, but who are not willing to file down their healthy tooth enamel. Another key benefit is that
the procedure is entirely reversible. Just like regular porcelain veneers, prepless veneers can
beautifully reshape your teeth and reverse tooth damage, improving your smile. Dr. Rink has placed
over 15,000 veneers in his career and will help determine if this treatment is right for you.

[Learn More About Prepless Porcelain Veneers][172]

## Dental Crowns

A dental crown is a fitted cap placed over a tooth to improve its shape, size, appearance, and
function. It can be used to help protect weakened teeth, staving off breakage, or it can be used to
protect a tooth that has recently received a filling. Crowns can also be used to hold dental bridges
in place. Dr. Rink’s work is always meticulously detailed, leaving you with a picture-perfect smile.

[Learn More About Dental Crowns][173]

## Dental Implants

When the roots of the teeth become compromised, a dental implant is used as a replacement. The
implants are designed to match your natural teeth, and thus create aesthetic harmony. They are
strong and stable, providing a healthy foundation for your smile. With the right [dental
implants][174], your speech, comfort, and oral health can all be improved, not to mention your
physical appearance.

[Learn More About Dental Implants][175]

## Your Charleston Home for Cosmetic Dentistry

You don’t have to live with concerns about your teeth or the feeling that you have to hide your

## Dr. John F. Rink The Cosmetic Expert

Dr. Rink has been delivering outstanding aesthetic results for 40 years, establishing his reputation
as one of the most reliable, friendly, and skilled dental practitioners in his field. Dr. Rink
obtained his undergraduate and dental degrees from the University of North Carolina School of
Dentistry at Chapel Hill, and completed a demanding fellowship in implant dentistry at the
Bowman-Gray School of Medicine. Additionally, he is a graduate of the L.D. Pankey Institute for
Advanced Dental Education. Dr. Rink is Charleston’s first accredited dentist in the [American
Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry][167], the world’s leading organization in aesthetic dentistry.
Dentists that have achieved this accreditation status have demonstrated the highest level of skill
and expertise and are committed to excellence in responsible aesthetics. Dr Rink is one of fewer
than 450 dentists in the world that have achieved AACD accreditation status.

[ Read Bio ][168]

## Full Mouth Restoration

When all the teeth in the patient’s mouth are in need of replacement, full mouth restoration is
performed to reestablish a healthy smile. Those who have suffered injury or accidents, were born
with congenital conditions, or who have a history of decaying, cracked, or otherwise damaged teeth
may be the best candidates. Treatments may include crowns, [bridges][169], veneers, implants, or
dentures, with every procedure tailored to your unique needs and wishes.

[Learn More About Full Mouth Restoration][170]

## Smile Makeover

One of the specialty services at our South Carolina practice is a smile makeover — a combination of
restorative dentistry procedures that can dramatically improve your smile and has the ability to
change your life. Dr. John Rink will craft a custom set of dental services that work together to
achieve your goal of having a smile that complements all your best features.

[Learn More About Smile Makeover][171]

## Prepless Porcelain Veneers

Prepless veneers are an excellent option for those who want to improve the aesthetics of their
teeth, but who are not willing to file down their healthy tooth enamel. Another key benefit is that
the procedure is entirely reversible. Just like regular porcelain veneers, prepless veneers can
beautifully reshape your teeth and reverse tooth damage, improving your smile. Dr. Rink has placed
over 15,000 veneers in his career and will help determine if this treatment is right for you.

[Learn More About Prepless Porcelain Veneers][172]

## Dental Crowns

A dental crown is a fitted cap placed over a tooth to improve its shape, size, appearance, and
function. It can be used to help protect weakened teeth, staving off breakage, or it can be used to
protect a tooth that has recently received a filling. Crowns can also be used to hold dental bridges
in place. Dr. Rink’s work is always meticulously detailed, leaving you with a picture-perfect smile.

[Learn More About Dental Crowns][173]

## Dental Implants

When the roots of the teeth become compromised, a dental implant is used as a replacement. The
implants are designed to match your natural teeth, and thus create aesthetic harmony. They are
strong and stable, providing a healthy foundation for your smile. With the right [dental
implants][174], your speech, comfort, and oral health can all be improved, not to mention your
physical appearance.

[Learn More About Dental Implants][175]

## support sensitive teeth and enamel health

###### using Hydroxi™ w/ nano hydroxyapatite

[Learn More][88]

originally developed by NASA for astronauts.

Our teeth & bones are largely composed of a natural mineral called hydroxyapatite with our enamel
being made up of about 97% hydroxyapatite.

Nano hydroxyapatite (nHa for short), was originally synthesized by NASA as a way to repair &
regenerate bone & enamel that astronauts were losing while out in space.

are your teeth addicted to drugs?

Most sensitive toothpastes use a nerve numbing agent called potassium nitrate to temporarily numb
the nerves of the teeth, but when the drug wears off, the tooth pain returns.

Get lasting support for sensitive teeth with Davids Hydroxi™ formula featuring nano hydroxyapatite.

## elevated oral care

Davids high-performance formulas are made using the highest quality naturally sourced and naturally
derived ingredients to safely and effectively neutralize the bad bacteria in your mouth, remove
cavity-causing plaque, naturally whiten and remineralize the enamel on teeth, and freshen your
breath.

Davids is a high-performing, clean ingredient toothpaste that actually works.

premium ingredients
[Davids kids and adults toothpaste in red tube placed on fresh watermelon slices]

## premium ingredients

Davids is committed to being good to the environment by formulating oral care products with
ingredients that are naturally sourced and naturally derived. The ingredients in our non-fluoride
toothpaste, mouthwash, oil pulling, and other oral care products are plant- and earth-based and
processed to enhance performance and safety.

[learn more][90]
sustainable packaging
[Davids toothpaste with key roller next to bamboo toothbrush on glass against mint green background]

## sustainable packaging

Each year, about 1.5 billion toothpaste tubes end up in U.S. landfills. We wanted to do better. You
may have thought we selected the metal tube for its modern aesthetic (that was part of it), but the
main reasons why Davids comes in metal tubes are for maintaining maximum freshness and for their
ability to be recycled.

Our aluminum tubes are lined with a food-grade, non-BPA liner so there is no paste-to-metal contact,
preventing any leaching of the tube material into our non-fluoride toothpaste.

originally developed by NASA for astronauts.

Our teeth & bones are largely composed of a natural mineral called hydroxyapatite with our enamel

regenerate bone & enamel that astronauts were losing while out in space.

### Leading Cosmetic Manufacturer in Ahmedabad for Third-Party & Private Label Manufacturing

Cremon Cosmetics is a trusted cosmetic manufacturer in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, specializing in
high-quality third-party cosmetic manufacturing, private label manufacturing, and custom formulation
services. We partner with startups, established brands, wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and
exporters to manufacture premium skincare, hair care, oral care, and personal care products that
meet today’s market demands.

From effective face wash, body lotions, serums, toothpaste, hair care products, and soaps to
customized cosmetic formulations, our experienced team combines advanced manufacturing processes,
carefully selected ingredients, and stringent quality standards to deliver products that help brands
grow with confidence. Whether you’re launching a new product or expanding your existing range,
Cremon Cosmetics provides reliable manufacturing solutions tailored to your business goals.

### A Cosmetic and Personal Care Manufacturer Built on Formulation Expertise

Cremon Cosmetics Pvt Ltd started with a simple goal: give brand owners in Gujarat and across India a
manufacturing partner they don’t have to worry about. Our facility at Sanand GIDC-2, Ahmedabad,
brings together formulators, quality staff and production teams who work on skincare, haircare and
personal care products every single day.

We work with a wide mix of clients – first-time entrepreneurs launching a single product,
established pharma and wellness brands scaling a full range, and salons or clinics wanting their own
retail line. Whatever the starting point, the process stays the same: understand the brand,
formulate the product, manufacture it under controlled conditions, and pack it ready to sell.

Today, Cremon Cosmetics manufactures skincare creams, body lotion, face wash, skin serum, hair
serum, shampoo, conditioner, toothpaste, soap, hand wash, body wash, gels and ointments for clients
including HealSure Lifesciences, Aprotic Pharma and Solnest Pharma. [Read more about our
company.][62]

#### What is Water Fluoridation?

Unlike all other water treatment processes, fluoridation does not treat the water itself, but the
person consuming it. It’s outdated, unnecessary, and harmful.

Fluoridated water is the largest source of exposure for most people, but it is not the only source
of exposure to fluoride.

#### Health Effects of Fluoride

Fluoride is a highly toxic substance that can cause a range of adverse health effects. Certain
members of the public are at particularly high risk of harm.

the planet! Aluminium can be recycled directly back into itself over and over again with almost no
energy loss. This is a true closed loop.

all aluminium produced is still in use today. This means it is one of the most recycled materials on
the planet! Aluminium can be recycled directly back into itself over and over again with almost no
energy loss. This is a true closed loop.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

# [HealingCancerNaturally.com]Healing Cancer Naturally

## Welcome!

Do not let either the medical authorities or the politicians mislead you. Find out what the facts
are, and make your own decisions about how to live a happy life and how to work for a better world.
Linus Pauling, two time Nobel laureate (Chemistry and Peace)

Hi and Welcome! Thank you for visiting Healing Cancer—Naturally! You will find a wealth (1000+
pages) of useful and interesting information on this site devoted to the extensive field of
alternative non-intrusive healing modalities for cancer that have proven successful for people with
this serious challenge!

Before, During or After Chemotherapy and Radiation?

What can you do to reduce side effects, support your body, and recover more effectively? Discover
practical, research-based strategies you can start using today. [[Learn More][63].]

I aim to give you an all-round “holistic” view of the many natural, gentle and/or non-intrusive ways
that have been used to heal cancer while placing particular emphasis on those **cancer cures that
are affordable** for next to everyone and easy to implement.

So you’ll find information under [Why Alternative Cancer Treatment?][64] (crucial reading), [Nature
Heals][65], [Healing Cancer • Naturally!!!][66], [**"Greatest Hits"**][67] (distilling twenty years
of research into the best while simplest and least expensive natural cancer cures), [Healing Cancer
& Your Mind][68], [Budwig Diet][69], [Geopathic Stress][70], [Spirituality][71], [Gerson Diet][72],
[Nutrition][73], [Detoxification][74], [Juicers & Juicing][75], [Supplements & Herbs][76], [Ozone
Treatment][77], [Causes of Cancer][78], [Energetic Studies into Cancer][79] (incl. [Selecting the
Right Cancer Treatment by Using Applied Kinesiology][80]), [Emotions][81] incl. very instructive
real-life stories of spontaneous remission and healing of “terminal” cases, [History of Alternative
Cancer Treatment][82], [Light][83], [Love][84], [Free Downloads][85] and more related subjects,
particularly [many stunning and uplifting Cancer Healing Testimonials][86]...

## Welcome!

Do not let either the medical authorities or the politicians mislead you. Find out what the facts

alternative non-intrusive healing modalities for cancer that have proven successful for people with

Before, During or After Chemotherapy and Radiation?

What can you do to reduce side effects, support your body, and recover more effectively? Discover

I aim to give you an all-round “holistic” view of the many natural, gentle and/or non-intrusive ways

& Your Mind][68], [Budwig Diet][69], [Geopathic Stress][70], [Spirituality][71], [Gerson Diet][72],
[Nutrition][73], [Detoxification][74], [Juicers & Juicing][75], [Supplements & Herbs][76], [Ozone
Treatment][77], [Causes of Cancer][78], [Energetic Studies into Cancer][79] (incl. [Selecting the
Right Cancer Treatment by Using Applied Kinesiology][80]), [Emotions][81] incl. very instructive
real-life stories of spontaneous remission and healing of “terminal” cases, [History of Alternative
Cancer Treatment][82], [Light][83], [Love][84], [Free Downloads][85] and more related subjects,
particularly [many stunning and uplifting Cancer Healing Testimonials][86]...

Simultaneously, in my ongoing selection of the information to be featured here, I have striven to
include especially such scientific and spiritual data and sources as may be harder to find, as
opposed to oft-repeated (and occasionally un- or half true) statements found in many places.

The page [Healing Cancer][87] succinctly outlines what currently seems to be the most comprehensive
overall approach to healing this and other disease. This approach is three-pronged and consists of
addressing and healing the
* Spiritual and energetic causes
* Emotional/mental factors in disease development
* Physical causes (toxicity, lack of nutrients, supporting the body to naturally self-heal as it is
  “designed” to do).

Healing Cancer Naturally is born from my interest in natural non-invasive healing modalities to help
maintain the body in health and perfection. More specifically, its inception dates from the time
when my best friend’s mother developed colon cancer. Based on the rich and amazing evidence I have
found, its basic message can indeed be summed up into: [Cancer Is Healable—Naturally!!!][88]

As a now healed former cancer patient wrote, ”For me the first and hardest part was healing the
mind, losing the 'Cancer is Killing Me' idea and coming to terms with the emotional trauma... Once I
believed with my heart that my body can overcome the disease there was an overnight improvement in
general health.”

You will find MANY tools and pointers here to both heal the emotional trauma AND the cancer (see for
instance [Emotions][89], [Energetics][90], [Dr Ryke Geerd Hamer’s “German New Medicine”][91],
[Healing Cancer & Your Mind][92], [“Greatest Hits”][93] and [Healing Cancer][94]).

### Healing Cancer Naturally is based on three fundamental “credos” and commitments:

1 The human body is designed to be self-healing and will beautifully do its assigned task if we
properly support and/or don’t hinder it in the performance of this basic function. This is why the
overwhelming majority of Healing Cancer Naturally’s pages is devoted to diet, detoxification, and
mental, energetic and spiritual factors in healing and health.

MUST-READ

[Cancer overdiagnosis and overtreatment][95]
Misdiagnoses abound—do be aware!

2 Information and help should be made available to anyone afflicted with cancer or other illness,
regardless of the size of their pocketbook. This is why Healing Cancer Naturally provides all its
potentially life-saving information for free rather than selling part of it in book form. And this
is why it asks for and needs [donations][96] and other [support involving no extra costs][97]
instead.

That's also the reason why simple and inexpensive “DIY” ways people have used to heal from cancer
(or in the official parlance, have achieved remission) get top priority. Expensive “alternatives” to
conventional treatment (and there are some very expensive ones indeed) will either be ignored,
mentioned only "on the side" or subjected to much higher standards (such as proof of effectiveness
via double-blind placebo-controlled peer-reviewed human studies).

3. Healing Cancer Naturally believes that any challenge, be it in the area of health, relationships
and/or finances, can (and optimally perhaps should) be used as a personal growth experience,
allowing the person undergoing and eventually victoriously overcoming the challenge to arise from it
not only healthier but also wiser and a better person than ever before.

### Why would anyone choose to consider curing cancer alternatively?*

or, for that matter, to look for a natural cure for cancer, either in the place of (or as a
complement to) the officially recommended (and sometimes enforced) chemotherapy, radiation and
surgery?

UNSOLICITED COMMENT

“Many alternative websites contain a lot of negative, conspiracy-theory-type ideas about allopathic
medicine that are not at all true in my experience. Every single oncologist I know wants the very
best for his/her patients and to see them healed and happy. They truly believe that chemo and
radiation are the patient's best chance at survival, and that they are doing the right thing by
using those modalities. It's just that THEY DON'T KNOW THAT THE BODY CAN HEAL ITSELF! We are not
taught that in medical school and it is not a prevailing belief in our society.” From a letter sent
by an MD

The main reason may be that conventional cancer treatment is still far from reaching its long
sought-after victory over cancer. This sadly is true even after decades of intensive research into
which billions of dollars have been poured.

On the contrary, cancer incidence and mortality have continued to steadily and dramatically rise in
the Westernized world, with no end to this tendency in sight. (In fact, the front page article of
the March 22, 2004 issue of Fortune Magazine was entitled, [Why We Are Losing the War On
Cancer][98].)

This has led many to think that the conventional approach (more drugs and surgery) may not be the
answer. It appears that it clearly fails to address the root causes, which, when unaddressed, may
(even in the relatively rare event of a temporary remission being achieved as shown in [cancer
statistics][99]) lead to a recurrence and exacerbation of previous symptoms.

In fact, as seen from [Possible side effects you may not have been told about][100], conventional
cancer care can trigger new and similarly serious illnesses. These, ironic & facetious as it may
sound, include death.

One of the most important reasons for preferably avoiding conventional treatment can be found out by
asking your doctor two simple questions. See "After A Cancer Diagnosis and before choosing any
conventional treatment (chemo, radiation, surgery), [ask your oncologists two basic
questions][101]".

### Why is cancer on the rise?

There are many suspected root causes. There is strong evidence that the depletion of our soils due
to intensive farming beginning with the industrial revolution has led to widespread mineral and
trace element deficiencies leading to (or promoting) in their turn numerous ailments incl. cancer.

MUST-READ

[“Should I Be Tested for Cancer?][102]
Maybe Not and Here's Why".

Another cause is likely to be found in the dangerous harsh chemicals present in our polluted food,
air and water supply, ranging from pesticides to artificial hormones (present in meat and dairy from
non-organic husbandry). Another factor are the ubiquitous electromagnetic fields from appliances,
cell phones, computers, TVs, microwaves etc. which no one can escape.

All of these are assaultive, unnatural substances and influences our bodies have to contend with on
a daily basis without, and this may be a crucial point, having had the evolutionary time to adapt to
them.

In tandem with this onslaught of toxins works the widespread intake of devitalized, demineralized,
industrially produced food low in nutrition and high in calories. This kind of diet is far removed
from what more naturally-living and much healthier peoples have consumed and is another major
suspect in the genesis of cancer.

And many seem to compound the problem by the intake of medicinal drugs and noxious substances,
themselves all too often the contributing cause of disease and worse, even death (compare [On
Drugs][103]).

There is also reason for the contention that all disease has a psychosomatic causative agent if not
root cause, in other words stress and inner wounding in all of their multiple forms.

MUST-SEE

[All books written and published by HealingCancerNaturally.com and HealingTeethNaturally.com][104]

A similar idea has been expressed by those (such as Traditional Chinese Medicine [TCM]) who claim
that all or most disease is due to or based upon a blockage of “energy”. This is said to lead to a
corresponding weakness in the organ and/or system affected by such undersupply (or lack of flow) of
“vital energy”.

Healing Cancer Naturally is indeed a proponent of the “energetic” viewpoint of disease and healing
(at the very least if one considers that at its most basic level, absolutely everything is simply
energy).

(Also see [Causes of Cancer][105] for a summary and extensive discussion of suggested and observed
causes of cancer.)

### What may be the solution to cancer?

overwhelming majority of Healing Cancer Naturally’s pages is devoted to diet, detoxification, and
mental, energetic and spiritual factors in healing and health.

MUST-READ

[Cancer overdiagnosis and overtreatment][95]
Misdiagnoses abound—do be aware!

2 Information and help should be made available to anyone afflicted with cancer or other illness,
regardless of the size of their pocketbook. This is why Healing Cancer Naturally provides all its
potentially life-saving information for free rather than selling part of it in book form. And this
is why it asks for and needs [donations][96] and other [support involving no extra costs][97]
instead.

That's also the reason why simple and inexpensive “DIY” ways people have used to heal from cancer
(or in the official parlance, have achieved remission) get top priority. Expensive “alternatives” to
conventional treatment (and there are some very expensive ones indeed) will either be ignored,
mentioned only "on the side" or subjected to much higher standards (such as proof of effectiveness
via double-blind placebo-controlled peer-reviewed human studies).

3. Healing Cancer Naturally believes that any challenge, be it in the area of health, relationships
and/or finances, can (and optimally perhaps should) be used as a personal growth experience,
allowing the person undergoing and eventually victoriously overcoming the challenge to arise from it
not only healthier but also wiser and a better person than ever before.

### Why would anyone choose to consider curing cancer alternatively?*

or, for that matter, to look for a natural cure for cancer, either in the place of (or as a
complement to) the officially recommended (and sometimes enforced) chemotherapy, radiation and
surgery?

UNSOLICITED COMMENT

“Many alternative websites contain a lot of negative, conspiracy-theory-type ideas about allopathic
medicine that are not at all true in my experience. Every single oncologist I know wants the very
best for his/her patients and to see them healed and happy. They truly believe that chemo and
radiation are the patient's best chance at survival, and that they are doing the right thing by
using those modalities. It's just that THEY DON'T KNOW THAT THE BODY CAN HEAL ITSELF! We are not
taught that in medical school and it is not a prevailing belief in our society.” From a letter sent
by an MD

The main reason may be that conventional cancer treatment is still far from reaching its long
sought-after victory over cancer. This sadly is true even after decades of intensive research into
which billions of dollars have been poured.

On the contrary, cancer incidence and mortality have continued to steadily and dramatically rise in
the Westernized world, with no end to this tendency in sight. (In fact, the front page article of
the March 22, 2004 issue of Fortune Magazine was entitled, [Why We Are Losing the War On
Cancer][98].)

This has led many to think that the conventional approach (more drugs and surgery) may not be the
answer. It appears that it clearly fails to address the root causes, which, when unaddressed, may
(even in the relatively rare event of a temporary remission being achieved as shown in [cancer
statistics][99]) lead to a recurrence and exacerbation of previous symptoms.

In fact, as seen from [Possible side effects you may not have been told about][100], conventional
cancer care can trigger new and similarly serious illnesses. These, ironic & facetious as it may
sound, include death.

One of the most important reasons for preferably avoiding conventional treatment can be found out by
asking your doctor two simple questions. See "After A Cancer Diagnosis and before choosing any
conventional treatment (chemo, radiation, surgery), [ask your oncologists two basic
questions][101]".

### Why is cancer on the rise?

There are many suspected root causes. There is strong evidence that the depletion of our soils due
to intensive farming beginning with the industrial revolution has led to widespread mineral and
trace element deficiencies leading to (or promoting) in their turn numerous ailments incl. cancer.

MUST-READ

[“Should I Be Tested for Cancer?][102]
Maybe Not and Here's Why".

Another cause is likely to be found in the dangerous harsh chemicals present in our polluted food,
air and water supply, ranging from pesticides to artificial hormones (present in meat and dairy from
non-organic husbandry). Another factor are the ubiquitous electromagnetic fields from appliances,
cell phones, computers, TVs, microwaves etc. which no one can escape.

All of these are assaultive, unnatural substances and influences our bodies have to contend with on
a daily basis without, and this may be a crucial point, having had the evolutionary time to adapt to
them.

In tandem with this onslaught of toxins works the widespread intake of devitalized, demineralized,
industrially produced food low in nutrition and high in calories. This kind of diet is far removed
from what more naturally-living and much healthier peoples have consumed and is another major
suspect in the genesis of cancer.

And many seem to compound the problem by the intake of medicinal drugs and noxious substances,
themselves all too often the contributing cause of disease and worse, even death (compare [On
Drugs][103]).

There is also reason for the contention that all disease has a psychosomatic causative agent if not
root cause, in other words stress and inner wounding in all of their multiple forms.

MUST-SEE

[All books written and published by HealingCancerNaturally.com and HealingTeethNaturally.com][104]

A similar idea has been expressed by those (such as Traditional Chinese Medicine [TCM]) who claim
that all or most disease is due to or based upon a blockage of “energy”. This is said to lead to a
corresponding weakness in the organ and/or system affected by such undersupply (or lack of flow) of
“vital energy”.

Healing Cancer Naturally is indeed a proponent of the “energetic” viewpoint of disease and healing
(at the very least if one considers that at its most basic level, absolutely everything is simply
energy).

(Also see [Causes of Cancer][105] for a summary and extensive discussion of suggested and observed
causes of cancer.)

Great care isn’t just about the tools you use; it’s about how everything works in harmony to create

# Innovation

## Innovation means more moments like this

We're driven by our deep understanding of the root causes of disease, focusing our R&D in areas like
cancer, HIV, and respiratory diseases where we can make the most meaningful difference for people.

[Discover more about our R&D approach][205]
[Close video][206]

## Who we are

As a focused biopharma company, we discover, develop and deliver medicines and vaccines to create
value for patients and shareholders. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by
the end of the decade.

Our R&D focus is on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV;
and infectious diseases.

# Innovation

## Innovation means more moments like this

We're driven by our deep understanding of the root causes of disease, focusing our R&D in areas like
cancer, HIV, and respiratory diseases where we can make the most meaningful difference for people.

[Discover more about our R&D approach][205]
[Close video][206]

## Who we are

As a focused biopharma company, we discover, develop and deliver medicines and vaccines to create
value for patients and shareholders. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by
the end of the decade.

Our R&D focus is on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV;
and infectious diseases.

# The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Bible

This project works from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church’s canonical tradition, preserved
through the ancient Geʽez manuscript lineage and transmitted to the Church through centuries of
faithful use.

When compared alongside the King James Bible, differences in wording, cadence, and structure reveal
how translation traditions can shape the way God’s character is heard—sometimes emphasizing
immediacy, severity, or judgment in English where older Semitic traditions preserve sequence,
restraint, and relational continuity.

The Ethiopian canon represents the oldest continuously used biblical tradition in the world, with
manuscripts dating to the 5th–6th century AD. Its textual witness does not change events or
doctrine, but often preserves tone and narrative flow in ways that allow readers to perceive
continuity between the God of the Old Testament and the Christ revealed in Jesus.

This study does not seek to replace Scripture, but to listen more carefully to it—by placing the
King James Bible and the Ethiopian Orthodox canon side by side and allowing the language itself to
speak.

# The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Bible

This project works from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church’s canonical tradition, preserved
through the ancient Geʽez manuscript lineage and transmitted to the Church through centuries of
faithful use.

When compared alongside the King James Bible, differences in wording, cadence, and structure reveal
how translation traditions can shape the way God’s character is heard—sometimes emphasizing
immediacy, severity, or judgment in English where older Semitic traditions preserve sequence,
restraint, and relational continuity.

The Ethiopian canon represents the oldest continuously used biblical tradition in the world, with
manuscripts dating to the 5th–6th century AD. Its textual witness does not change events or
doctrine, but often preserves tone and narrative flow in ways that allow readers to perceive
continuity between the God of the Old Testament and the Christ revealed in Jesus.

This study does not seek to replace Scripture, but to listen more carefully to it—by placing the
King James Bible and the Ethiopian Orthodox canon side by side and allowing the language itself to
speak.

demineralization and remineralization of hard tissue of teeth. Because of food residues or
incomplete brushing, it can cause minerals in the teeth to dissolve and lose until cavities form.
The fluoride in toothpaste can make the remineralization effect greater than the demineralization
effect, so that dissolved mineral salts re deposited on the tooth, thereby preventing the
development of dental caries. It's important to understand fluoride correctly! Because of this,
fluoride began to appear in toothpaste. The amount of fluoride ion in toothpaste is generally
1000mg/kg, and a large number of clinical trials have shown that dental caries are reduced by about
20%-30%. If the mass fraction of 0.02% or 0.05% sodium fluoride is added to the gargle, caries can
be reduced by 40%. Since the 1980s, the number of caries patients has decreased significantly, which
is closely related to fluoride toothpaste. Therefore, it is certain that adding fluoride to
toothpaste can reduce dental caries, but it is difficult to reliably assess the optimal dose of
fluoride in toothpaste. At the same time, in the process of gradual use, the two sides of fluorine

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[**FREE** Advice][188] [Learn More][189]
Is it really FREE?

YES! I (Dr. Hannan) wanted to remove any barriers to gaining great dental advice. Send me a question
– you have nothing to lose and everything to gain!

What if I have questions after receiving the report?

Feel free to ask! I’m here to help you fully understand your dental health for confident treatment
decisions. Just reply to the email, and I’ll respond ASAP!

What happens if I don’t receive my report within 48 hours?

Check your spam folder! If you still don’t see anything, email me at [[email protected]][190] and I
will get back to you ASAP!

Will my information be kept confidential?

Absolutely, your information’s security is crucial. Our website is securely hosted on BigScoots, and
all emails are encrypted with [Google Workspace HIPAA][191] and [Business Associates Agreement
(BAA)][192].

How do I receive x-rays from my dentist?

Most dentists have digital x-rays that can be easily shared. Just ask your dentist for a records
release to get them via email, fax, mail, or in person. You can even snap a photo of your x-rays
during your visit.

What if I have a dental-related question but no x-rays?

Request x-rays from your dentist. If you think an x-ray isn’t needed, just fill out our detailed
questionnaire, and I’ll address your questions based on the provided information within 48 hours.

Will medication be prescribed?

No, unfortunately, we’re unable to prescribe medication.

Is it really FREE?

YES! I (Dr. Hannan) wanted to remove any barriers to gaining great dental advice. Send me a question
– you have nothing to lose and everything to gain!

What if I have questions after receiving the report?

Feel free to ask! I’m here to help you fully understand your dental health for confident treatment
decisions. Just reply to the email, and I’ll respond ASAP!

What happens if I don’t receive my report within 48 hours?

Check your spam folder! If you still don’t see anything, email me at [[email protected]][190] and I
will get back to you ASAP!

Will my information be kept confidential?

Absolutely, your information’s security is crucial. Our website is securely hosted on BigScoots, and
all emails are encrypted with [Google Workspace HIPAA][191] and [Business Associates Agreement
(BAA)][192].

How do I receive x-rays from my dentist?

Most dentists have digital x-rays that can be easily shared. Just ask your dentist for a records
release to get them via email, fax, mail, or in person. You can even snap a photo of your x-rays
during your visit.

What if I have a dental-related question but no x-rays?

Request x-rays from your dentist. If you think an x-ray isn’t needed, just fill out our detailed
questionnaire, and I’ll address your questions based on the provided information within 48 hours.

Will medication be prescribed?

No, unfortunately, we’re unable to prescribe medication.

## Frequently asked questions

A quick overview of who we are, who we serve, and how to get started with a wholesale account.

What is Supermarket Distributors of America? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is a New York-based major wholesale supplier and distributor of
health, beauty, personal care, OTC, baby care, household and cleaning products serving wholesalers,
large-volume institutional buyers, pharmacies, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
corner markets and superstores across the United States and North America.

Does SDA function as a supplier or a distributor? +

SDA operates as both. We act as a **wholesale supplier** by sourcing factory-fresh inventory
directly from manufacturers, and we serve as a **distributor** by managing the logistics of
delivering that bulk stock to supermarkets, pharmacies, and discount stores.

What types of products does Supermarket Distributors of America supply? +

We supply a wide range of national and regional brands across health, beauty, personal care, OTC
medicines, baby care, household and cleaning supplies, paper goods, oral care, feminine care, and
more.

Who can buy from SDA? +

SDA is a business-to-business wholesale distributor. Customers typically include superstores,
schools, independent grocers, drug stores, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
wholesalers, hotels and institutional buyers. We do not sell directly to consumers.

What areas do you serve? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is based in New York and supplies customers throughout New York
and across the United States and North America through its wholesale distribution network.

How do I open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America? +

To open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America, merchants and vendors can
contact our sales team using the contact form or call our office. A representative will review your
business information, discuss your needs, determine applicable volume discounts and help you
complete any required account setup documentation.

Do you have minimum order requirements? +

Yes, minimum order requirements may apply and can vary by category, program and shipping
destination. Initial orders starting at $1000. Please contact our sales team to review current
minimums and wholesale order terms for your business.

Which types of stores and customers does Supermarket Distributors of America specialize in? +

We specialize in supplying superstores, independents, neighborhood grocery stores, discount and
dollar stores, pharmacies, convenience stores, government contractors and large-volume orders for
institutional buyers that need reliable wholesale health, beauty, personal care, OTC, and household
products.

How do I get pricing or open a wholesale account? +

To request pricing or open a wholesale account, retailers can use our [contact form][165] on the SDA
website or call **(631) 273-3900**. A sales representative will review your business information,
product availability, pricing and volume discounts, delivery details, service area and categories of
interest to help you get started.

## Frequently asked questions

A quick overview of who we are, who we serve, and how to get started with a wholesale account.

What is Supermarket Distributors of America? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is a New York-based major wholesale supplier and distributor of
health, beauty, personal care, OTC, baby care, household and cleaning products serving wholesalers,
large-volume institutional buyers, pharmacies, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
corner markets and superstores across the United States and North America.

Does SDA function as a supplier or a distributor? +

SDA operates as both. We act as a **wholesale supplier** by sourcing factory-fresh inventory
directly from manufacturers, and we serve as a **distributor** by managing the logistics of
delivering that bulk stock to supermarkets, pharmacies, and discount stores.

What types of products does Supermarket Distributors of America supply? +

We supply a wide range of national and regional brands across health, beauty, personal care, OTC
medicines, baby care, household and cleaning supplies, paper goods, oral care, feminine care, and
more.

Who can buy from SDA? +

SDA is a business-to-business wholesale distributor. Customers typically include superstores,
schools, independent grocers, drug stores, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
wholesalers, hotels and institutional buyers. We do not sell directly to consumers.

What areas do you serve? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is based in New York and supplies customers throughout New York
and across the United States and North America through its wholesale distribution network.

How do I open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America? +

To open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America, merchants and vendors can
contact our sales team using the contact form or call our office. A representative will review your
business information, discuss your needs, determine applicable volume discounts and help you
complete any required account setup documentation.

Do you have minimum order requirements? +

Yes, minimum order requirements may apply and can vary by category, program and shipping
destination. Initial orders starting at $1000. Please contact our sales team to review current
minimums and wholesale order terms for your business.

Which types of stores and customers does Supermarket Distributors of America specialize in? +

We specialize in supplying superstores, independents, neighborhood grocery stores, discount and
dollar stores, pharmacies, convenience stores, government contractors and large-volume orders for
institutional buyers that need reliable wholesale health, beauty, personal care, OTC, and household
products.

How do I get pricing or open a wholesale account? +

To request pricing or open a wholesale account, retailers can use our [contact form][165] on the SDA
website or call **(631) 273-3900**. A sales representative will review your business information,
product availability, pricing and volume discounts, delivery details, service area and categories of
interest to help you get started.

**Supermarket Distributors of America** is a B2B wholesale distributor of **health, beauty, personal
care, OTC, baby care, household, and cleaning products,** supplying **retailers, wholesalers,
merchants, and institutional buyers across North America.**

#### **AS SEEN ON**

Welcome to ShunCulture, your ultimate destination for exploring the fascinating world of culture in
all its diverse glory!

Here, we embark on a journey to uncover the unique and captivating cultural aspects that define
communities and nations across the globe. From ancient traditions that have stood the test of time
to modern practices that shape our present, we delve into the heart of what makes each culture
unique.

### Latest tips and guides

> At ShunCulture, our mission is to bridge the gap between different cultures, fostering a deeper
> understanding and appreciation for our shared human experience.

We believe that culture is the very fabric that connects us, and through our blog, we aim to
showcase the beauty of our diverse world.

By fostering a dialogue around culture, we believe we can help people make even better decisions
that ultimately protect their tradition.

### Why join us?

###### Enrich Your Knowledge

You'll learn about different cultural practices, beliefs, cuisines, arts, and much more, enriching
your own perspective and knowledge.

###### Connect with a Global Community

You can share your own experiences, learn from others, engage in meaningful discussions, and make
connections that could last a lifetime.

###### Inspire Your Personal Growth

You'll be exposed to new ideas, challenge your own assumptions, and develop valuable skills such as
cross-cultural communication and critical thinking, which can benefit both your personal and
professional life.

### Review process at

The article review process includes a written piece, edited for clarity and conciseness, reviewed
for accuracy and completeness, and approved by the author.

##### [Written][9]

The draft should be clear and concise, and it should include all of the information that the
writters want to include in the final version.

##### [Edited][10]

Remove any unnecessary information and make sure that all of the information that is included is
easy to understand.

##### [Reviewed][11]

The review team checks all of the facts and figures that are included in the article and make sure
that they are correct.

##### [Approved][12]

The final step is to send to the author and sign off on the final version before publishing the
articles on ShunCulture
